def find_overlaps(intervals1, intervals2):
    overlaps = []
    i = 0
    j = 0
    while i < len(intervals1) and j < len(intervals2):
        s1, e1 = intervals1[i]
        s2, e2 = intervals2[j]
        # Find overlap
        start = max(s1, s2)
        end = min(e1, e2)
        if start < end:
            overlaps.append( (start, end) )
        # Move the pointer which ends earlier
        if e1 < e2:
            i += 1
        else:
            j += 1
    return overlaps

def get_free_intervals(work_start, work_end, busy_intervals):
    busy_intervals.sort()
    free = []
    current = work_start
    for start, end in busy_intervals:
        if current < start:
            free.append((current, start))
        current = max(current, end)
    if current < work_end:
        free.append((current, work_end))
    return free

def find_overlaps(intervals1, intervals2):
    overlaps = []
    i = j = 0
    while i < len(intervals1) and j < len(intervals2):
        s1, e1 = intervals1[i]
        s2, e2 = intervals2[j]
        start = max(s1, s2)
        end = min(e1, e2)
        if start < end:
            overlaps.append((start, end))
        if e1 < e2:
            i += 1
        else:
            j += 1
    return overlaps

def minutes_to_time(minutes):
    hours = minutes // 60
    mins = minutes % 60
    return f"{hours:02d}:{mins:02d}"

        else:

    else:  # Tuesday, but no candidates there
